entries.title: Summoner

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC; PlayStation Classics emulator for PS5/PS4
emulation.notes: Use Steam/GOG for the PC version. Use PS5/PS4 if trophies and console convenience matter more than PC flexibility.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release with modern compatibility guidance.

primary.why: The current Windows PC release on Steam/GOG is the best fidelity route because it uses the PC port rather than PS2 emulation and is officially available on modern PC storefronts.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Summoner on Steam or GOG and look into compatibility fixes if needed.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but the PC version has the higher display and storefront flexibility ceiling.
skip: PC base version, superseded for access by the current Steam/GOG PC release.
skip: historical port, not the highest-fidelity or most accessible current route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current PC storefront release through Steam/GOG, based on the Windows port.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current PC route and highest display flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: PS2 emulation release for PS5/PS4, with PlayStation Store availability and trophy support.
all_releases.reason: skip: best console convenience route, but it is PS2 emulation rather than the PC version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS5/PS4 release adds console convenience and trophies through PS2 emulation, while the PC release remains the fidelity pick.

entries.remaster_caveats: No full remaster or remake was identified; the PS5/PS4 release is a PS2 emulation release, not a remaster.

entries.title: Summoner 2

emulation.emulator: PCSX2; Dolphin for the GameCube port
emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for the primary route. Use Dolphin only if comparing Summoner: A Goddess Reborn.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: The original PS2 release is the best version because Summoner 2 was designed for PS2 first, while the GameCube version is a later retitled port with visual changes but no sourced exclusive content or clear completeness advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original PS2 disc on compatible hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for modern display options.

all_releases.reason: primary: original full release and best-sourced version.

all_releases.fidelity: GameCube port retitled Summoner: A Goddess Reborn, with visual changes.
all_releases.reason: skip: later port with title and visual changes, but no sourced exclusive content or clear completeness advantage over the PS2 original.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The GameCube port has visual changes and a new subtitle, but no sourced exclusive content or clear completeness gain; the PS2 original remains the primary.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified for Summoner 2.
